evidence: Changes P2P listen socket configuration in `src/net.cpp` and adds a functional test in `test/functional/feature_port.py`.
rationale: Prevents local port hijacking of incoming P2P connections on Windows by setting `SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE`. Commit c6971fd610 explains that without this, 'another process running under the same user account can bind to the same port and intercept incoming P2P connections'.
